# Ehlers Contracting Services, Inc.

> Remodeling contractor in Naples, Florida, owned by Rick Ehlers (Richard K. Ehlers), a licensed building contractor and lifelong Floridian who has worked in Naples' premier communities for more than 20 years. Rick is involved in every detail of every job, from concept to completion: personal, courteous service, quality craftsmanship and a fair price. Florida license CBC1250125, Certified Building Contractor, held by Ehlers Contracting Services, Inc. and qualified by Richard K. Ehlers; current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Phone (239) 289-0896, email EhlersContracting@gmail.com. Homes and businesses: houses, condos, offices, shops and restaurants. Most projects fall between $10,000 (a bathroom) and $500,000 (a home addition).

## Services

- [Kitchens](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): custom cabinets and vanities, cabinet refacing, counters and backsplashes. 3D renderings show the room before work starts.
- [Bathrooms](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): showers, tile and vanities, designed and built.
- [Whole homes](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): several rooms, or the whole house, remodeled as one project.
- [Condos](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): units remodeled top to bottom: kitchens, baths, floors, master suites and lighting.
- [Screen enclosures](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): pool cages and lanai enclosures, including enclosures with insulated roof panels.
- [Additions](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): space added to the house you already have.
- [Floors](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): tile and wood floors, plus vinyl and laminate.
- [Commercial](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#services): offices, shops and restaurants, built out or remodeled.

## How a project runs

- [From concept to completion](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#rick): concept (you call or email Rick and talk the project through), design (plans and, when they help, 3D renderings), permit (pulled under license CBC1250125), build (the remodel itself, built to the approved plans), completion (the final inspection closes the permit).

## Work

- [Park Shore kitchen](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#work): from one of Rick's projects in Park Shore, Naples. White Shaker cabinets with cup pulls and round knobs, glass-front upper cabinets with X mullions lit from inside, a basketweave mosaic backsplash with under-cabinet lights, a polished lantern pendant with three candle lights, and floor-to-ceiling cabinets around the refrigerator.
- [Park Shore living room](https://ehlerscontracting.com/#top): white sofas and armchairs on a wide-plank light wood floor, a kitchen counter open to the room, and a wall of sliding glass doors onto the bay and its docks.
